name: cad_turn
description: Rotate the open design about its own centre, on the desk or expanded in front of the user (view only: nothing is rebuilt, and an expanded or exploded model stays expanded and exploded). For 'rotate it', 'turn it around', 'spin the robot', 'show me the back', 'tip it toward me', 'stop spinning', 'put it straight'. Works on every design (rocket, quadcopter, gearbox, humanoid robot, RC truck). degrees: turn it this far from where it is (90 a quarter turn, 180 turns it around, negative the other way; 90 if nothing else is given). axis: up (default) turns it about its vertical; side tips it toward (+) or away from the user. face: turn it so that side faces the user instead. spin: true keeps it turning slowly, false stops. reset: back to how it first stood.

degrees.description: How far to turn it from where it is now; negative turns it the other way.

axis.description: up: about its vertical (default); side: tip it.

face.description: Turn it so this side faces the user.

spin.description: true: keep turning slowly; false: stop.

reset.description: true: back to how it first stood.
